description:
This file defines the MetaResponse class, which implements the JsonSerializable interface and provides a dynamic container for arbitrary properties related to API response metadata in the JsonApi.

The class allows setting and getting properties dynamically, supports construction with initial properties, and implements jsonSerialize() to output these properties as JSON.

classes.name: MetaResponse
classes.description: A class representing metadata in a JSON API response that supports dynamic properties and JSON serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an array or stdClass of properties.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve a property value by name.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a property value by name.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the properties array for JSON encoding.
